# User-provided example images

These five files retain their original names and exact source bytes. The technical registry is `../../example-images-provenance.json`; source copies are in `assets/example-images/` at repository root.

QA must use these images in automated native-upload checks and manual assessment review. Do not rename, annotate, crop, edit or assign condition labels to them. Do not add captions or tell the model what an image depicts. Employee-entered case facts are separate from image observations. Inspect actual results without assuming an expected visual finding.
